changelog: - **A percent amount on a Converter's connection is refused instead of being read as a bare fraction.** On a Gate or Drain, `50%` means half of the source Pool; on a connection into or out of a Converter the same `50%` was read as 0.5 units per activation, whatever the Pool held, so the one expression meant two things without a word. A Converter's connection now accepts a number or `all`; a percent there moves nothing, and the run shows a diagnostic naming the connection and the expression. Your file is not changed: to keep what `50%` did on a Converter, write `0.5`.
